budget_rule: K=max(2,ceil(N/q)); mandatory endpoint calls count toward K
crb_stage_rule: Split K-2 discretionary calls as evenly as possible among coverage, error-risk, and recursive minimum-kappa; remainder assigned in that order
uniform_rule: K rounded evenly spaced anchors including both endpoints
reconstruction: linear interpolation of endpoint gradient vectors
selection_rule: Original seed-selected ordinal 771 plus 11 distinct draws without replacement from remaining 999 eligible manifest rows using seed 20261110
cache_retention: Release each dense gradient cache only after the per-track result and anchor-count validation; keep metrics, metadata, and selection
